EXACT POSITIVE ENDPOINT RECORD: RANGES 1 THROUGH 6
=================================================

All coordinates, endpoints, and convex weights below are exact rationals.
This records consequences of the PRESERVED incoming geometric histories.
It does not supply an independent derivation of those incoming histories.
The continuous replacements are joined in C1092-ALL-EIGHT-TERMINALS.md.

Sector i uses R^(-i), R(x,y)=(4-y,x). The actual central owner C is
Q_(4+i), J is the next central owner, and B is Q9,Q10,Q11,Q8 in order.
Every center interval encloses all vertices of all retained pose polygons,
using the original grid scale 1/100000000. Independent interval subtraction
only enlarges possible displacements; no independence assumption is made.

U=(1,87/50), T=(87/50,2), and L=(8/5,1) already follow from the
original auxiliary table. A=(1,1) is strict in the actual corner owner.
The only new strict point consumed here is P=(2,1) in each boundary B.
Its exact certificate below uses vertices of that same actual owner.
A convex combination of strict interior points is strict even if some
weights vanish. Rotating the preceding boundary P gives the foreign
D=(1,2) for every central square, so D is not a separate premise.

ANGLE AND SIGN CONVENTIONS

The displayed central intervals are the raw retained canonical cells.
The separate actual maximum-angle condition places the selected positive
half-angle in [k/64,(k+1)/64] and bounds every other absolute central
half-angle by it. The combined maximum in ranges 1 through 6 is 7/64.
A coarse raw cell can extend farther; the geometric maximum condition
must be retained when that happens. Maximum-angle ties are permitted.

The boundary cells combine into [-1/63,7/64], inside [-1/8,1/8].
Ranges 1 and 2 may contain central negative angles. Their mixed-sign
possibilities are excluded in C1092-MIXED-SIGNS.md using the aggregate
displacement bounds from these same center intervals. Ranges 3 through 6
already have nonnegative central cells. All-positive configurations are
excluded throughout by C1092-POSITIVE-CYCLE.md.
